findings.rationale: Valid regression from the closure-g1 fold. Depth-0 fold at the cap: cursor gains coverage floor f (forward-only); every read uses L = max(t - s, f); next w pruned at max(newT - s, f), so the slack regrows only as newT passes f and never reopens pruned history; red-checks s2/s3 with case cursor-overflow-nodup.
Same defect as f5b5ce22e7; also e becomes [group ts, greatest id] kept until the group ts falls below L, so an oversized group cannot be re-emitted after t advances (red-check s3).
Folded: every exit-2 path prints the same error object under --json, described in events.schema.json as a second top-level shape.
Folded: uncaughtException/unhandledRejection handlers route to the same fallback; stream error events become rejections in jsonl-tail.js.
Folded: one git cat-file --batch-check process per call for all bases.
Folded: default decision ledger dropped from the warning list; an absent default ledger or runs dir is state absent with no warning.
